## Earthquakes

```{r}
#| label: setup-earthquake
#| include: false
if (file.exists("_quarto.yml")) here::i_am("scan-calculations/earthquake_charts.qmd")
if (!exists("aoi")) {
  source(here::here("core/R/setup.R"))
}
aoi <- aoi %>% st_as_sf() %>% st_transform("EPSG:4326")
```

```{r}
#| label: data-loading-earthquake
#| include: false
eq <- tryCatch(
  read_csv(file.path(tabular_dir, paste0(city_string, "_earthquake.csv")), show_col_types = FALSE),
  error = function(e) { message("Earthquake data not available: ", e$message); NULL })
```

```{r}
#| label: earthquake-events
#| results: asis
#| fig.width: 12

if (is.null(eq) || nrow(eq) == 0) print_text(paste_bold('No earthquake data available')) else {

  if (!"source" %in% names(eq)) {
    eq$source <- if (all(c("damageAmountOrder", "deaths", "intensity") %in% names(eq))) "NCEI" else "USGS"
  }

  for (col in c("damageAmountOrder", "damageMillionsDollars", "deaths", "deathsAmountOrder",
                "intensity", "tsunamiEventId")) {
    if (!col %in% names(eq)) eq[[col]] <- NA
  }

  USGS_MIN_MAG <- 4.5

  y_ratio <- 51498 / 13514

  city_point <- aoi %>% st_combine() %>% st_centroid()

  eq_near <- eq %>%
    subset(!is.na(latitude)) %>%
    st_as_sf(coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), crs = st_crs(city_point)) %>%
    mutate(distance = st_distance(geometry, city_point) %>% units::set_units(km),
          magXdist = eqMagnitude * (2000 - units::drop_units(distance))) %>%
    filter(distance < units::set_units(500, km)) %>%
    filter(
      (source == "NCEI" & coalesce(
         damageAmountOrder >= 2 | damageMillionsDollars >= 1 |
           deaths >= 10 | deathsAmountOrder >= 2 |
           eqMagnitude >= 7.5 |
           intensity >= 10 |
           !is.na(tsunamiEventId), FALSE)) |
      (source == "USGS" & coalesce(eqMagnitude >= USGS_MIN_MAG, FALSE))
    )

  if (nrow(eq_near) == 0) {
    print_text(paste_bold('No significant earthquakes found within 500 km'))
  } else {

  damages <- c("0" = "None", "1" = "Limited", "2" = "Moderate", "3" = "Severe", "4" = "Extreme")

  eq_text <- eq_near %>%
    mutate(
      location = if_else(
        source == "NCEI",
        gsub("([\\s-][A-Z])([A-Z]*)", "\\1\\L\\2", locationName, perl = T) %>%
          str_extract("[^:][\\s]+.*") %>% trimws(),
        str_to_title(locationName)),
      day = replace_na(day, 1),
      BEGAN = as.Date(paste(year, month, day, sep='-'))) %>%
    arrange(BEGAN) %>%
    mutate(
      line1 = toupper(paste(lubridate::month(BEGAN, label = T, abbr = F), lubridate::year(BEGAN))),
      line2 = paste0("M", eqMagnitude, "; ", scales::label_comma(accuracy= 1)(units::drop_units(distance)), " km away"),
      fatalities = if_else(
        source == "NCEI" & !is.na(deaths),
        paste(scales::label_comma()(deaths), "fatalities") %>%
          str_replace_all(c("^1 fatalities$" = "1 fatality")),
        ""),
      damage = if_else(
        source == "NCEI" & !is.na(damageAmountOrder),
        paste(damages[as.character(damageAmountOrder)], "damage"),
        ""),
      text = if_else(
        source == "NCEI",
        paste(line1, line2, damage, fatalities, sep = "; ") %>%
          str_replace_all(c("; ;" = ";", "; $" = "")),
        paste(line1, line2, sep = "; ")))

  eq_text <- eq_text %>%
    mutate(above_line = (2*(row_number() %% 2) - 1)*-1) %>%
    mutate(node_x = BEGAN + y_ratio * 1460*above_line,
          node_y = above_line * (1460 * tanpi(1/6) + 466/2) * y_ratio )

  # Structured table: Date, Location, Magnitude, Distance, Damage, Fatalities
  eq_text %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    arrange(BEGAN) %>%
    transmute(
      Date        = format(BEGAN, "%B %Y"),
      Location    = location,
      Magnitude   = eqMagnitude,
      `Distance (km)` = round(units::drop_units(distance)),
      Damage      = if_else(damage == "", "—", damage),
      Fatalities  = if_else(fatalities == "", "—", fatalities)
    ) %>%
    print_paged_df()

  eq_plot <-
    ggplot(eq_text, aes(y = BEGAN, x = drop_units(distance))) +
    geom_text_repel(
      data = \(x) slice_max(x, magXdist, n = 10), aes(label = text),
      size = 4, hjust = 0, direction = "y",
      xlim = c(515, 1000),
      segment.color = "grey46", segment.size = .25,
      segment.curvature = 1e-20, segment.square = T) +
    geom_point(data = \(x) filter(x, !is.na(eqMagnitude)), aes(size = eqMagnitude), shape = 1, color = "black") +
    geom_point(data = \(x) slice_max(x, magXdist, n = 10), aes(size = eqMagnitude), color = "grey46") +
    geom_point(data = \(x) filter(x, is.na(eqMagnitude)), shape = 1, color = "grey92") +
    scale_x_continuous(
      limits = c(0, 500),
      labels = \(x) paste(x, "km"),
      breaks = seq(0, 500, 100),
      expand = expansion(c(0, 0))) +
    {
      earliest_year <- min(lubridate::year(eq_text$BEGAN))
      year_floor <- as.Date(paste0(earliest_year, "-01-01"))
      range_years <- as.numeric(format(Sys.Date(), "%Y")) - earliest_year
      step <- if (range_years <= 20) 5 else if (range_years <= 60) 10 else 20
      scale_y_continuous(
        limits = c(Sys.Date(), year_floor),
        breaks = seq.Date(year_floor, Sys.Date(), by = paste(step, "years")),
        minor_breaks = seq.Date(year_floor, Sys.Date(), by = "1 year"),
        labels = \(x) format(x, "%Y"),
        trans = c("date", "reverse"))
    } +
    scale_size(range = c(1, 6)) +
    labs(
      x = paste("Distance from", city),
      y = "Year",
      size = "Magnitude") +
    theme_minimal() +
    coord_cartesian(clip = 'off') +
    theme(
      axis.line = element_line(linewidth = .5, color = "black"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.justification.right = "bottom",
      legend.direction = "horizontal",
      legend.box.margin = margin(0, 0, -37, 15),
      plot.margin = margin(5.5, 300, 5.5, 5.5, "pt"),
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NULL))

  ggsave(here("03-render-output", "plots", "ngdc-earthquake-scatter.png"), plot = eq_plot, device = "png",
          width = 15, height = 4.36, units = "in", dpi = "print")

  tryCatch(print(eq_plot), error = \(e) warning(paste("Window may be too small for earthquake plot.", e)))
  cat("\n\n")

  # Summary bullet points
  n_eq          <- nrow(eq_near)
  earliest_eq   <- min(eq_near$year, na.rm = TRUE)
  closest_eq    <- eq_text %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% slice_min(distance, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE)
  closest_dist  <- round(units::drop_units(closest_eq$distance[1]))
  closest_mag   <- closest_eq$eqMagnitude[1]
  closest_date  <- format(closest_eq$BEGAN[1], "%B %Y")

  print_text(glue("Since {paste_bold(earliest_eq)}, there have been {paste_bold(n_eq)} significant earthquakes recorded within 500 km of {paste_bold(city)}, as reported in the U.S. National Centers for Environmental Information's Significant Earthquake Database (NCEI) and the USGS."))
  print_text(glue("The closest recorded event was a magnitude {paste_bold(closest_mag)} earthquake in {paste_bold(closest_date)}, with an epicenter {paste_bold(closest_dist)} km from {paste_bold(city)}."))

  }
}
```
